CommunityApplications.Profile: Backuparr backs up the apps you host - media management, downloaders, media servers, network, security, home automation and server apps (the full list: https://docs.backuparr.com/apps/) - with encrypted backups sent to local storage, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and S3-compatible Cloud Storage, all set up from its web UI. The Unraid template uses the same image as every other install. Documentation: https://docs.backuparr.com/ - report problems on GitHub: https://github.com/rsaturns/backuparr/issues
